facts.fact: Tunisia's national telecoms authority (INT), using ITU data, reports that the monthly high-consumption basket (140 minutes of calls, 20 SMS and 5 GB of data, so a mixed voice, SMS and data basket and not data alone) costs 1.53% of monthly GNI per capita; no date for the figure is given, so as_of is the article's published date.

systems.system: INT/ITU high-consumption basket (140 min, 20 SMS, 5 GB): nominal price
